POCO Holding.why: metal soft-magnetic chip inductors power GPUs and ASICs in AI servers; modular inductors for vertical power delivery were over 70% of its H1 2026 inductor revenue
POCO Holding.evidence: POCO Holding investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-22-2026): modular inductors are used with customers in vertical power delivery (VPD) architectures, mainly for ASIC and GPU end uses; modular inductors were over 70% of H1 inductor component revenue

players.product: Metal soft-magnetic materials and chip inductors (including modular inductors for vertical power delivery) that supply front-end power to GPU, CPU, ASIC and FPGA chips in AI servers

quarterly_data.quarter: POCO Holding investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: modular inductors are used with downstream customers in vertical power delivery (VPD) architectures and, according to the industry chain, mainly go into ASIC and GPU end uses; a modular inductor's unit value is generally 2 to 3 times a traditional inductor's, and TLVR inductors are also harder to make and higher in value. Modular inductors were over 70% of H1 2026 inductor component revenue, and penetration will accelerate further in H2.
quarterly_data.figure: modular inductors over 70% of H1 2026 inductor revenue; unit value 2-3x traditional inductors
